Method of Attack: Distributed via SPAM emails pretending to be missed delivery notifications from UPS
SPAM emails contain JS file attachments that download PHP script ransomware component
PHP script scans drives for targeted files and encrypts them without changing file extensions
Skips encryption of files in system folders (winnt, boot, system, windows, tmp, temp, program, appdata, application, roaming, msoffice, temporary, cache, recycle)
Encrypts files with a wide range of extensions
Displays ransom note Decrypt.hta with ransom amount and payment instructions
Attack Vector: SPAM email attachments containing malicious JS and PHP scripts
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note named Decrypt.hta with distinctive red background

Payment servers URLs containing 'counter' string: http://luxe-limo.ru/counter/?[victim_id], http://musaler.ru/counter/?[victim_id], http://vinoteka28.ru/counter/?[victim_id], http://www.agrimixxshop.com/counter/?[victim_id], http://sharedocsrl.it/counter/?[victim_id]
Ransom note instructions including Bitcoin payment to specified address
Presence of encrypted files without extension changes
SPAM emails pretending to be UPS missed delivery notifications
